text:
Evan: Quick ask 90-min battlecard refresh for next week's launch. Need 3 headlines, 4 bench callouts, and a 1-page SDR crib.
Marta: Copy. Target audiences: Devs, Platform, and Procurement. We'll need slightly different tone per segment.
Sam: For devs: punchy, hands-on claims. For procurement: unit economics and SLA language.
Ivy: Bench ideas: p50 latency (chat 256), p95 cost per 1k tokens, failure recovery time, and multi-region failover. Keep numbers as ranges, legal-friendly.
Evan: Agreed. Draft headline options: 1) "Serving first, not last" 2) "Same API. Better economics. Predictable SLAs." 3) "Ship models with production confidence."
Marta: I like 2 for landing page, 1 for social tiles. Need 6-word ad variants too.
AE-Leads: SDRs asked for two rebut lines: A) "We use cloud provider X" B) "Ops is too hard." They want one-sentence counters + a sample demo ask.
Sam: Counters: A) "We work with cloud infra, not against it 7 keep your stack, improve unit economics via smart routing." B) "We provide dedicated tooling and managed fallbacks so your team avoids building runtime plumbing."
Marta: Okay. Now the battlecard lines vs categories (keep <18 words + supporting bullet):
- Cloud AI platforms: "Broad platform services; inference economics vary with real traffic mixes."
  Support: "Internal tests show cost variance across p95 under mixed load."
- LLM APIs: "Fast start, limited rollout controls and caching primitives."
  Support: "Most public APIs lack native KV-cache and canary pin features."
- Infra vendors: "You provision hardware but still need serving optimizations to hit SLOs."
  Support: "Teams implement batching/caching/quantization ad hoc, delaying production."
Ivy: For benchmarks copy: use conservative phrasing: "up to" only when we have exact data. Prefer: "materially lower per-token cost for production mixes" w/ footnote.
Design-bot: Drafted 1-slide benchmark hero and 3 social tile sizes: https://figma.com/file/abc/webinar-launch-v4.
Evan: Routing plan for leads: tag webinar leads with q=webinar_launch and score by engagement: views>50% + clicked-trial -> high. HubSpot rule: q=webinar_launch & score>=80 -> AE queue.
AE-Leads: Add region-based routing: EMEA -> EMEA_AE; APAC -> APAC_SDR. Also set enterprise-spend>200k -> AE handoff.
Marta: Legal: can we use "materially lower"? Need quick sign-off language.
Legal: Fine if we add footnote: "based on internal benchmarks across representative workloads; results vary by config."
Sam: Follow-up sequence draft: Day0: thanks + trial link; Day2: benchmark snapshot; Day5: invite to 1:1 demo. SDRs want a 72h priority for high-score leads.
Evan: Deliverables: Marta to own copy lock, Sam to assemble slide, Design-bot to produce assets, AE-Leads to finalize rebut crib and routing, Legal to sign the footnote.
Marta: Timeline: copy drafts in thread by EOD today. Review 9:30am tomorrow. Design assets by 4pm tomorrow. :rocket: 
Design-bot: Also exported 6-word ad options: "Serve reliably. Save more. Ship faster." and "Same API. Lower cost. Safer rollouts."
AE-Leads: We'll add demo script and SDR 1-pager once copy locked. Tagging @Marta for updates.
Marta: Thanks all. Drop drafts here and I'll do a final competitor ping with Legal before assets go to staging.
